messages.text: Please tell me someone has already reported the espresso machine on 14. It's flashing some angry red light and just gurgling at me.
Same on 12. It was making a grinding noise yesterday afternoon too. I think it's finally given up.
Day one of no espresso. Risk team is officially operating at reduced VaR (Vibes at Risk).
Christopher, that's going in the next risk committee deck. Also, has facilities been pinged? I'll email them if not.
Red light plus gurgling usually means it needs descaling or the pump is clogged. I've seen this on the same model. Did anyone try the descale cycle?
Vincent, I held the button combo from the sticker on the side and it just beeped three times and went back to red.
Three beeps is probably the water tank sensor. Pull the tank out and reseat it firmly. Sometimes the float gets stuck.
Tried it. Light went from red to blinking amber. Progress? Or a different kind of bad?
Amber blinking is warming up, I think. Give it ten minutes before you judge it.
Morning all. Facilities has a technician scheduled for this afternoon, just in case. Please leave the machine alone until then so we don't void anything. Thanks for flagging it.
Thanks Linda. Appreciate the fast response. Coffee crisis averted, or at least scheduled.
Update: the amber light turned green and I just got a drinkable shot out of it. Vincent, you're a hero.
Happy to help. Still let the technician look at it though, the grinding is probably a separate issue.
Calling it now: the machine deserves a pension and a gold watch. Cappuccinos on me if it survives till Friday.
